dataset.not_horizons_reason: GFM scenes are not daily 6–72 h maps. Do not invent those labels.

events.note: Independent events = meteorological episodes separated by >45 days. Two city tiles on the same flood are one event. Orbit pairs two days apart are one event. Multiple 21-day revisits inside one monsoon are one event.

inventory.note: Independent events = meteorological episodes separated by >45 days. Two city tiles on the same flood are one event. Orbit pairs two days apart are one event. Multiple 21-day revisits inside one monsoon are one event.

copernicus-gfm-ensemble-flood-extent.temporal_resolution: S1 revisit ~6–12 d; 192 h scene slot
copernicus-gfm-ensemble-flood-extent.note: Headline OBSERVED label. Expand years/orbits, do not replace.

opera-dswx-s1.note: Same S1 revisit class as GFM. Do not train a second classifier or merge labels.

viirs-modis-nrt.note: Optical, cloud-heavy, different flood definition and unknown process.

global-flood-database.note: Event-max climatology, not t0→t+192 h forecast labels. NC. Do not mix into headline metrics.

giezendanner-bangladesh.note: DERIVED 8-day ~500 m. Never call OBSERVED. Do not mix with GFM.

glofas-rapid-flood-mapping.note: MODELLED RP inundation. Comparison candidate, not training labels.

emsr.note: Phase 4 found 0 Bangladesh rows in the public list.

worldfloods-sen1floods11.note: Same-time mapping / often NC. Wrong task for these AOIs.

sylhet_diagnosis.note: Sylhet's 0.8° box lies on E039N021T3 (not N024). On covering Sunamganj orbits, Sylhet valid_frac is ~0.1% because the SAR swath that lights Sunamganj does not cover Sylhet city. This is footprint mismatch, not a 5% threshold bug and not solved by enlarging the AOI. Neighbor tile E039N024T3 does not contain the AOI.

event_independence.research_rule: Official Gate B FAIL if <20. Research: PROVISIONAL 20–29; PASS ≥30 with no split leaks. Not a silent definition change.

channel_audit.note: A convolutional model needs within-tile spatial variance. Broadcast rain/Q/month are TEMPORAL-ONLY, not spatial features.
